_comment: Phase NP (non-peptide ligands). See PHASE_NONPEPTIDE.md. 'reuse' names sources already pinned by cur0a_acquire.py from sources.json; np0 only sets their shippable flag and asserts they are present.

mrclinkdb_human_mr.name: MRCLinkdb metabolite L-R interactions (human)
mrclinkdb_human_mr.licence: CHECK - no licence stated on site; Zhang et al. BMC Biol 2024, PMID 38978014
mrclinkdb_human_mr.note: Use THIS file, not the Zenodo deposit. Zenodo human_mr.txt has 4 cols / 681 rows and no PMID; this has 15 cols / 794 rows with PMID and Other.DB.

mrclinkdb_human_enzyme.name: MRCLinkdb metabolite enzymes (human)
mrclinkdb_human_enzyme.note: enzyme_p_s: p = produces, s = consumes. Signed role, which MetaLigand lacks.

mrclinkdb_human_transporter.name: MRCLinkdb metabolite transporters (human)
mrclinkdb_human_transporter.note: No direction stated; maps to role=efflux with a direction_unknown flag.

metalinksdb.name: MetalinksDB knowledge graph (SQLite, via LIANA+)
metalinksdb.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo 10200150); Farr et al. Brief Bioinform 2024, PMID 39038934
metalinksdb.note: 9744 distinct lr pairs, 9433 of them STITCH-only. pathway table partly corrupt (18 fragment values, 781 rows) - do not import.

metaligand_pairs_human.name: MetaLigand NPL-receptor pairs (human)
metaligand_pairs_human.licence: MIT (Jin 2026); Xin et al. Cell Rep Methods 2025, doi 10.1016/j.crmeth.2025.101217
metaligand_pairs_human.note: Three columns: row index, L (compound name), R (gene symbol). No IDs, no evidence.

metaligand_ligands_human.name: MetaLigand per-ligand gene sets (human)
metaligand_ligands_human.note: Carries HMDB_id, Synonyms, and the four gene groups: Synthetic_genes, Synthetic_genes_lv2, Transporter_genes, Transporter_genes_in.

metaligand_ligand_list.name: MetaLigand ligand classification
metaligand_ligand_list.note: Class / SuperClass / Class_source. Class_source is usually 'ChEBI Ontology' but no ChEBI accession is stored.

mebocost_human.name: MEBOCOST metabolite-sensor partners (human)
mebocost_human.licence: RESTRICTED - no redistribution outside the research group, no derived database or website. Zheng et al. NAR 2025, doi 10.1093/nar/gkaf569
mebocost_human.note: shippable=0 is a LICENCE constraint, not a quality one. np6_export.py must assert no row sourced here reaches release/. Only source with 100% PMID coverage (793/793), so it is valuable as an internal cross-check.

mebocost_human_enzymes.name: MEBOCOST metabolite-associated enzymes/reactions (human)
mebocost_human_enzymes.licence: RESTRICTED - as mebocost_human. Zheng et al. NAR 2025, doi 10.1093/nar/gkaf569
mebocost_human_enzymes.note: direction: substrate = metabolite consumed (degradation), product = metabolite made (synthesis). gene field is 'SYM[evidence]; SYM[evidence]'. Internal cross-check only.
